page.overview:
Who is Cestus?

Cestus was a male Human Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. He was also an Overseer of the Korriban Sith Academy during the Cold War against the Galactic Republic. Cestus was killed in 3637 BBY when a Republic strike team was sent to secure Sith datacrons and artifacts on Korriban.
